summary: Repairs the two Blocking findings left open by .3.2.1. Protected-presentation attestation now serializes exactly the eight HPAC-REQ-092 fields (attestation_version, presentation_id, approval_id, approval_subject_digest, human_visible_representation_digest, descriptor_digest, election, presented_at) and no others; installed-mechanism authority and permanently-non-real classification remain proven by the already-closed writer-provenance sidecar and FIXTURE_NON_REAL verifier-kind channels, untouched here. Canonical-store containment adds require_safe_relative_id_component, enforced before any file I/O, to the HPAC lifecycle store and the inert Gate-9 authority-consumption store, closing the absolute-path/Path.__truediv__ escape. No contract modified; no CONTRACT/IMPLEMENTATION INCOMPATIBILITY encountered. Recommends .3.2.2.1 independent verification; Layer 3 not begun.
derived_correctness: HPAC-REQ-092's exact eight-field closed schema was re-derived from docs/contracts/HUMAN_PRINCIPAL_AUTHENTICATION_CONTRACT.md (HPAC-001 v2.0) rather than inferred from the pre-repair implementation. The pre-repair attestation object was diffed field-by-field against that schema, confirming installation_store_id and simulation_only as the two contract-forbidden fields. The containment defect was independently reproduced with isolated temporary state: pathlib.Path.__truediv__ discards the left operand when the right is absolute, so an unvalidated caller-supplied proof_id let HPACLifecycleStore._dir() and RuntimeInvocationAuthorityConsumptionStore._path() resolve outside their configured roots before any check ran. require_safe_relative_id_component mirrors the existing _validate_mechanism_id single-path-component pattern and is invoked before any file I/O in both stores.
